question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH period_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01' THEN 'January–June 2025'
      WHEN ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01' THEN 'July–December 2025'
    END AS reporting_period,
    CUSTOMER_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_BASE
  WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT reporting_period, COUNT(*) AS repeat_customers
FROM period_orders
WHERE order_count > 1
GROUP BY reporting_period
ORDER BY reporting_period
action.metrics: Number of distinct customers with more than one recorded order within each half of 2025; all order statuses included.

action.answer: January–June 2025 had 95,048 repeat customers; July–December 2025 had 96,514. Repeat status was evaluated separately within each period: a repeat customer had more than one recorded order in that half. The counts include orders of all statuses. July–December had more repeat customers, by 1,466.
